responsibility: This header declares the public interface to gfortran’s compile-time arithmetic subsystem. It exposes model-precision setup, range checking, constant comparison, constant-folding operators, and the family of kind/type conversion helpers used across parsing, resolution, simplification, and target-memory code when manipulating gfc_expr constant values.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public API for compile-time arithmetic—range checks, comparisons, folding operators, and conversion entry points—used by other front-end files. Unlike gcc/fortran/arith.cc, it does not perform the arithmetic or conversions itself.
